title: ReceiptSignature
description: Sidecar written by `agent-receipt sign` next to a Markdown receipt (`foo.md` → `foo.sig.json`). The signature is over the UTF-8 bytes of the receipt sha256 hex string (the same hex verify uses), not the raw Markdown. `publicKey` is the SPKI PEM so a peer can verify without `.agent-receipt/keys/`. The private key is never included. This is a local Ed25519 attest, not a CA or PKI certificate. Default `verify` stays hash-only. `verify --require-sig` requires this sidecar. `prove` reports it when it is present. `share` and Markdown `export` copy it when the published sha256 matches, or re-sign the published Markdown when the body was rewritten and local keys exist. HTML is unsigned. `share --package` writes the same document as `receipt.sig.json` and, when local keys load, as `manifest.sig.json` over the sha256 hex of `manifest.json` bytes.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. Only Ed25519 in this version.

sha256.description: Receipt sha256 hex that was signed, as 64 lowercase hex characters.

fingerprint.description: Key fingerprint: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the DER-encoded SPKI bytes of publicKey.

signature.description: Base64-encoded raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the UTF-8 bytes of sha256.

publicKey.description: SPKI PEM public key. Peers verify with this key. Must not be a private key.
